1.c4 g5 2.d4 Bg7.strategy: Gives up the g-pawn for pressure on d4, but White simply takes it with the bishop and Black's compensation is thin. A gambit that costs a pawn for pressure White can parry.
1.c4 g5 2.d4 Bg7.name: English Opening: Myers Gambit

1.c4 g5 2.d4 e5.strategy: Offers the e-pawn to open the queen's diagonal, so the queen now defends g5, and the f8 bishop's diagonal. White just takes the pawn and Black has too little for it, so the gambit is dubious.
1.c4 g5 2.d4 e5.name: English Opening: Zilbermints Gambit
